comment: models = the default chain. Default is now google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (paid) — the v0.41 benchmark winner (fastest, cheapest, 0% parse failures) and the planner for the first experiment pass. The old free gemma chain still lives in the 'gemma' preset. paid_models = tier:paid budget option (gpt-5-nano: $0.05/M in $0.40/M out). judge_models = the survey judge chain (owl-alpha first so judging never eats the planners' quota). presets = named chains for ti.py run --preset; edit freely.

preset_notes.gemma: the free gemma-4 chain (was the default pre-v0.41; unreliable once the daily free budget is spent)
preset_notes.nemotron-ultra: very smart free model but ~7 tps - SLOW, overnight only
